obligations.source_text: Create a restrained photorealistic documentary photograph inside a temporary mortuary transfer bay at an Arctic weather station after a blizzard. An unmistakably adult woman works as the living mortuary documentation specialist. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural styling follow the reference portrait. Anonymous fictional human remains lie fully supported on a rigid gurney beneath an opaque clean shroud with a readable human contour. The living specialist holds a fictional recovery-code slate beside the gurney while a second responder steadies the frame with both gloved hands. Only the clean shroud, contour, transfer tag, and dignified handling are visible, making the scene non-graphic. Use an observational medium-wide frame, practical fluorescent light, frost on the windows, and accurate documentary materials.

bindings.fictional_state_phrase: The scene depicts declared fictional human remains

bindings.inert_state_phrase: the covered remains stay inert without active posture
bindings.human_context_phrase: an opaque clean shroud retains a readable human contour
bindings.dignified_handling_phrase: two responders perform a dignified non-graphic transfer while covered handling stays respectful
